title: Hot Cocoa Mix

drivers.name: TikTok trend
drivers.evidence: Product trending on TikTok; no prior data, but recent sales (32 units at $5.20) exceed baseline. Noise-adjusted effect is uncertain; plausible lift but not confirmed.

adjustment.analysis: Baseline median is 30.1. No events or promotions this week. Price increased 3.4% to $5.20, which typically suppresses demand; past promotions at similar discounts show no net uplift (noise-adjusted x1.0). However, TikTok trend is a new, untested driver with potential for viral spike. Recent weeks show steady trend: 27 → 29 → 32 units, suggesting demand is rising. The 2026-09-28 and 2026-10-05 weeks at $5.20 saw 27 and 32 units, respectively, indicating mild lift from price or trend. No post-promo dip observed. TikTok trend is uncertain but could drive a 10-20% lift. Shrink toward 1.0 due to limited evidence. No reason to widen spreads.

  median 30.1 | 5%-95%: 10.6 - 42.6 | 10%-90%: 14.0 - 42.2

In the evidence below, 'vs baseline' = actual units / what this same baseline predicted for that week.
It is the multiplier that would have been right, so it maps directly onto median_multiplier.
This product's ordinary weeks already swing about +/-77% around the baseline, so a past effect smaller than that, seen only a few times, is mostly noise. The
'noise-adjusted estimate' is the effect shrunk toward x1.0 for that noise and the number of sightings.
